author: National Geographic
description:
What exactly happened to the city of Pompeii and its citizens when Mt. Vesuvius erupted over 2000 years ago? Join Tom Hiddleston and National Geographic on a journey into the past to better understand the full history of Pompeii. Through conversations with archaeologists, historians, and experts, Tom begins to piece together the stories of survivors, fulfilling a lifelong fascination with the ancient world. The team utilizes new archaeological research with cutting edge technology to create an experiential account of the fateful day the city was buried under ash. Be prepared to never think about Pompeii the same way again. 

Pompeii: Out of Time with Tom Hiddleston is now streaming on Disney+ and Hulu.

description:

In this episode of Lost Cities from National Geographic, explorer Albert Lin uncovers great feats of water engineering around the world, from the Nabataean Empire in the Middle East to Pohnpei Island in Micronesia.
